parcels.where: DOR_CODE_CUR LIKE '01%' AND (TRUE_MAILING_STATE <> 'FL' OR TRUE_MAILING_ZIP_CODE <> SUBSTRING(TRUE_SITE_ZIP_CODE,1,5) OR TRUE_MAILING_ADDR1 <> TRUE_SITE_ADDR_NO_UNIT)

signals.name: bldg_violation
signals.label: open building code violation (county)
signals.where: CASE_TYPE = 'All Other Code Violations' AND OPEN_DATE >= DATE '2020-01-01'

signals.name: code_lien
signals.label: code enforcement lien on the property (county)

signals.name: collections
signals.label: unpaid code fines sent to collections (county)

signals.name: foreclosure_registry
signals.label: foreclosure registry case (lender has started foreclosure)

signals.name: housing_case
signals.label: open housing or structure maintenance case (county)
signals.where: STAT_DESC LIKE 'Open%' AND (PROBLEM_DESC LIKE 'Minimum Housing%' OR PROBLEM_DESC LIKE 'Structure Maintenance%')

signals.name: nuisance_case
signals.label: open junk, overgrowth or abandoned property case (county)
signals.where: STAT_DESC LIKE 'Open%' AND (PROBLEM_DESC LIKE 'Junk/Trash%' OR PROBLEM_DESC LIKE '%Abandoned Property%')

ui.name: Miami
ui.title_cos: First International Title, Capital Title Group, Avanti Way Title, all in Miami
ui.title_call: First International Title or Capital Title Group
ui.law: Florida lets you assign a purchase contract. Never market the house itself, only your contract, and put the assignment right in the contract. Florida is a judicial foreclosure state, so lis pendens filings are public at the Miami-Dade Clerk.
ui.groups: "Miami REIA", "South Florida Real Estate Investors", "Miami Wholesale Deals"
ui.prefc: Foreclosure registry: Miami-Dade makes lenders register a house once they start foreclosing, so an open registry case means the bank has already filed. Code liens and collections are fines the owner has not paid; they attach to the house and come off the sale price. Unsafe structure cases come from the county building department after an inspection.
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the county sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on Sunbiz and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers found in the sale data yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Miami rough numbers per house: cosmetic 15-30k, kitchen+baths 35-60k, roof 18-30k (insurance needs it), impact windows and doors 15-35k, AC 8-14k, full gut 70-120k. Houses 40 years and older need the county recertification.
ui.sources: Miami-Dade Property Appraiser parcel layer (owner, mailing address, assessed value, last sale), Miami-Dade building department unsafe structure and open violation cases, Miami-Dade code compliance liens, collections, foreclosure registry, housing and nuisance cases
